rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a foreman leading a hands-on work crew, especially in construction or manual work.

example.english: The foreman gave the order, and everyone started work right away.
example.traditional: 呢班工友做嘢好快，工頭一聲令下，大家即刻開工。
example.jyutping: ne1 baan1 gung1 jau5 zou6 je5 hou2 faai3 gung1 tau2 jat1 sing1 ling6 haa6 daai6 gaa1 zik1 hak1 hoi1 gung1

rows.note: Use this for the supervisor of a workplace or production section, especially when the role is to manage staff rather than lead a temporary crew.

example.english: If I do not understand something, I ask the foreman directly.
example.traditional: 我有咩唔明，就直接問領班。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 me1 m4 ming4 zau6 zik6 zip3 man6 ling5 baan1

rows.note: Use this formal legal term for the jury member who presides over the jury and speaks for it.

example.english: The foreman of the jury read out the jury’s verdict.
example.traditional: 陪審團主席代表陪審團宣讀裁決。
example.jyutping: pui4 sam2 tyun4 zyu2 zik6 doi6 biu2 pui4 sam2 tyun4 syun1 duk6 coi4 kyut3
